description: Stand in the Plaza de San Jorge in old Cáceres at night, the church rising illuminated above the cobbled square. Its lit façade glows against the dark sky while the surrounding stone houses sit shadowed around the plaza. The old town's honeyed stone holds the lamplight, and the square lies quiet after the day's crowds.
